status: artist source-binding candidate; shared-runtime integration and visual acceptance pending

coordinateFrame.idScope: place-local; consuming compiler qualifies once with placeId; never prefix new-york twice

sourceFacts.historicalMaterialStatus: Original landmark structure and finish remain explicitly unassigned. None of this table changes that source history.
sourceFacts.geometry: Exact emitted composition after hidden-source replacements and actual floor cuts, including merged sourceRanges; not raw source plus access twice.
sourceFacts.appearance: Original appearance hashes/UVs/grossUV/normals/matrices remain unchanged; appearance does not assign physical material.
sourceFacts.rights: Preserve existing source provenance and rights limitations; no new license grant.

gameplayAssignments.authority: Architect acceptance of New York prototype table and exact three pilot carriers, under docs/milestones/29-shared-gameplay-maps.md
gameplayAssignments.quantityUnit: prototype-fuel-unit; finite gameplay quantities, not real-world mass
gameplayAssignments.profileOwner: Existing shared combustion kernel; this artifact does not tune rates or thresholds.

rules.inert: Raised base, approach/paving, glazing and door hardware have zero fuel; this does not disable physical screening, breakage or unsupported retirement.
rules.wall-area: Above-base exterior wall and native level-closure core: timber/clapboard; .16 m native depth; primary area times 1. Level 0 raised-base segments are stone.
rules.top-area: Building floors/decks, elevated porch/terrace/balcony/roof-decks and interior stair treads are timber/frame; upward projected area times 1. Front landing and level-1 porch paving plus approach caps/treads are stone. Slabs preserve .12 m thickness; stair solids retain original depth.
rules.weather-area: Closed authored pitched roof treated as timber-covering/roof; actual upward weather-face area times 1; buried underside excluded. This is a gameplay approximation, not a historical roofing-material finding.
rules.closed-volume: Window/portal frames, columns, rails and named substantial fittings: timber/frame; actual closed-solid volume divided by .12. Fine painted details add no separate coating fuel.
rules.leaf-area: Native 1 x 1.65 x .12 leaf plus its 1 x 1.15 x .12 extension share one door account: total panel area times .45. Metal handle remains a separate inert attached carrier.
rules.whole-awning: .3 cloth units once per whole canopy/valance/stripe assembly, including tower arch awnings.
rules.lacquer: Exactly .10 units on carrier/main/0/cell-1-22/1 only; separate finite pilot coating. No blanket lacquer assignment.

gameplayAssignments.unknownPolicy: Explicit unassigned records below are not timber and must not receive an implicit dry-timber fallback.

geometryPolicy.physicalGeometry: Only carrier-solid bindings contribute physical surfaces; awning stripes are appearance-only, following the same owner with no additional thermal surface or fuel.
geometryPolicy.collisions: Preserve exact closed solids/apertures and openMatrix/openBounds. Bounds are evidence and broadphase only, not replacement collision shapes.
geometryPolicy.support: Positive-area coplanar source-triangle contacts are recorded; hinges/hardware use native attachments. Side-face adjacency is separate from bearing. Unresolved/support-through-overlap or span decisions remain explicit; compiler/kernel owns live support resolution.
geometryPolicy.retirement: Canonical local carrier owns fuel/char/retirement persistently; all renderBindings follow it, including only sourceRange when present. Geometry/collision/support/sight retire together. Never remove an entire unrelated instanced batch or duplicate fuel on section reload. Inert support loss never creates timber fuel.

floorOpenings.note: Clip only this source floor ID; keep all other native levels and the raw source unchanged.

nativeAccess.floorOpeningCoordinates: access-plan source-local; add sourceOffset once when reading THIS original metadata; emitted carrier geometry already includes offset.
nativeAccess.supportSurfaces: navigation.surfaces (emitted-world); exact existing walking support including stairs/holes remains authoritative.
nativeAccess.stairs: navigation.accessPlan.stairs retains native source-local paths and treads; navigation.surfaces is the compiled-world walking evidence.
